title.narrative: Effective responses to drug-resistant tuberculosis in the Republic of Kazakhstan - Kazakhstan (01-Jan-2026-31-Dec-2028)

description.narrative: Kazakhstan, Tuberculosis, RSE on REU “National Scientific Center of Phthisiopulmonology of the Republic of Kazakhstan” of the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Kazakhstan (RSE on REU “NSCP RK" MH RK)This program has the following goals: Enhance the effectiveness and sustainability of TB control and elimination efforts in Kazakhstan. The objectives of this program are: Introduce and expand innovative diagnostic technologies to strengthen TB detection and management among KVP, enhance collaboration within multidisciplinary teams, and promote client-centered approaches.. Strengthen the rapid identification of drug-resistant TB, including RR/MDR-TB, to guide effective treatment regimens and improve patient outcomes.. Enhance advocacy and training initiatives to build the workforce capacity engaged in delivering integrated TB/comorbidity care and promote collaboration with partners and stakeholders for an effective TB response.. Support civil society and community engagement in TB and TB/HIV response to address access and service gaps for a comprehensive, inclusive, and sustainable approach.. Upgrade health information systems and enhance M&E for better data management and patient care in TB diagnostics, treatment and prevention.. Ensure equitable access to TB preventive treatment in both the civilian and penitentiary sectors.. Address barriers to TB diagnostics, treatment, and support services among KVP for timely care and improved health outcomes.. Sustain universal access to quality TB services through strengthened health systems and sustainable financing.
